mobbin:08aa493c-6111-43eb-a393-4f09e8b5f.summary: Recruiter opens a candidate overview, adds a Project scorecard with free-text notes and Strong Yes–Strong No, then sees Scorecard Submitted with the saved Strong Yes card.
steps: Scorecard — written notes + Strong Yes…Strong No
Submitted toast + Strong Yes result card
steal: Scorecards empty state with Add scorecard for [name] CTA (step Scorecards empty).
Footer rating strip: Strong Yes / Yes / No / Strong No color-coded (step empty notes + 4 ratings).
View all previous scorecards toggle above the form (step empty notes + 4 ratings).
Success banner Scorecard Submitted! then list card with reviewer, Strong Yes, and note body (step Submitted toast).
avoid: Free-text-only scorecard with no checklist criteria — Abbott-style checklist+timestamps fit SRV grading better than one essay + four hire buttons.
mobbin:08aa493c-6111-43eb-a393-4f09e8b5f.fit: Extends SRV Data Entry / evaluation variant: right-rail scorecard beside subject context, discrete summative scale + confirmation; lacks evidence timestamps and rubric rows Abbott already implies.
